The '''Kyoloria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]], which was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Kyolorian snake-god]] [[God/Legends|deity]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Kyolorian snake-god]]|system=Kyoloria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kyoloria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square Q-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
